Admission before queueing

POST /v1/tasks re-checks the caller after reading the body, then GUI
gate, capacity, credit; a repeated idempotency key replays. GET ?wait=
holds until the task ends.
Source: cloud/src/api/app.ts
Acknowledged is not yet durable

Writes are acked from memory; plane.json is rewritten atomically every
2 s if changed and on SIGTERM, so a crash can lose ~2 s of acked work.
Source: cloud/src/server.ts, cloud/src/core/persist.ts

Interaction view · columns = actors; frames = trust/deployment boundaries; vertical lines identify actors, not calls. Read labeled
arrows caller → recipient, response included. Solid = sync request; dashed = async delivery; dotted = local I/O. Numbered stages
define order; equal stages are alternatives; unnumbered calls are independent.
Claims, heartbeats, requeue

Claim long-polls ≤25 s. Unstarted 20 s after claim → requeue
(max 3 tries); box silent 2 min → running task fails, not rerun.
Heartbeat (15 s) delivers cancels.
Source: cloud/src/core/queue.ts, cloud/src/core/store.ts
Guarded claim, reset before the next

A slot claims only while the pf LAN guard checks out (fails
closed). Before its next claim it is reset: processes killed,
home wiped, account remade with a new uid.
Source: src/fleet/lan-guard.ts, src/fleet/reset.ts

The key stays on the plane

The customer's Anthropic key stays in plane memory for one run; the
slot gets an omt_ token. The proxy checks model, step budget and
max_tokens; no streaming.
Source: cloud/src/api/agent-routes.ts
Op relay and answer retries

Ops run concurrently as the slot user; each poll reports room. An answer
is resent with backoff until the plane takes it, and gets one try once
closing.
Source: src/fleet/sandbox.ts
